title: BriefIngestEventV1
description: Schema for a new campaign brief ingestion event.

ts.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the event was created.

campaign_name.description: The name of the marketing campaign.

target_market.description: The geographical or demographic market for the campaign.

target_audience.description: A description of the target audience profile.

campaign_message.description: The core message or slogan for the campaign.

image.description: A Dropbox path to a provided image, or null if one should be generated.

logo_path.description: A Dropbox path to a logo file to be included in the creatives.

inbox_folder.description: The Dropbox folder where the original brief and assets are stored.
